_meta.name: retrieval_queries_synthetic_v2
_meta.provenance: 63 queries (TUNING SET: the retriever's floors were chosen while looking at results on this set, so figures here are optimistic). Hand-written by the retriever's author and labelled against retrieval_corpus_synthetic.jsonl BEFORE the run that produced the numbers in docs/evaluation/retrieval.md. relevant = EVERY passage that states the answer fact (usually 1-5); an empty list marks an out-of-corpus query that must return nothing. Same author as the retriever, so NOT an independent test and NOT real-world accuracy. Includes 8 paraphrase / vocabulary-mismatch queries and 17 out-of-corpus queries, 12 of which share words with the corpus.
_meta.description: query -> relevant '<source>#<page>' passages; group labels the topic.
